name: Bad Ice Cream Resort
storyline:
Ahhh... The tropical island of Sunshine Cove. Once famous for its white sand, active wildlife, and traditional fruit-flavoured gelato. Tourism has graced its shores in recent years, with the island inhabitants craving something more. Now there's every type of entertainment from ship-dragged inflatable rides to extreme explosive volleyball and of course, the weekly volcano Big Island BBQ!

Imagine the peaceful islanders' surprise when a foreign treat arrived on the island: soft-serve ice cream. Packed with artificial sugar, colours and preservatives. Step aside healthy fruit snacks, there’s a new treat in town!

But this luxury resort is no holiday. Sunshine Cove is the exclusive turf of the Gelato Family, an old-school crime syndicate who want to keep things... traditional. They don't take kindly to cheap imitation ingredients, and anyone bringing soft-serve onto their island is looking for a one-way trip to the freezer.
summary: The legendary Bad Ice Cream trilogy finally gets a long-awaited, stand-alone sequel. The hit browser arcade classic returns rebuilt from scratch with beautiful hand-drawn HD art, a branching campaign map playable solo or in 1-4 player local co-op, and a frantic competitive Battle Mode across unlockable arenas.
